title: RBI conducts ₹25,000 crore Variable Rate Repo auction
body: RBI held an overnight VRR auction to inject short-term liquidity into the banking system and align money market rates with policy.
remember: Overnight tenor, funds return July 9|Bidding window 9:30-10:00 AM under LAF|Eligible: scheduled commercial banks & primary dealers
statics: Notified amount ₹25,000 crore|System liquidity surplus ~₹1.19 lakh crore (as of Jul 6)

title: IDFC FIRST Bank goes live with EPFO PF payment services
body: IDFC FIRST Bank became the private bank authorised by EPFO to let employers pay statutory PF contributions directly via its internet banking platforms.
remember: First private bank integrated for PF payments on EPFO Unified Portal|Employers can pay via Retail/Corporate Internet Banking
statics: EPFO founded 1952|HQ New Delhi|Chairman: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya

title: RBI approves N.S. Vishwanathan's reappointment as Axis Bank chairman
body: RBI approved a fresh three-year term for N.S. Vishwanathan as Axis Bank's Non-Executive Part-time Chairman.
remember: Term: Oct 27, 2026 to Oct 26, 2029|Former RBI Deputy Governor (retired 2020)|Chairman since Oct 2023
statics: Axis Bank founded 1993, HQ Mumbai|MD & CEO: Amitabh Chaudhry

title: Government issues ₹1.55 lakh crore in guarantees under ECLGS 5.0
body: The Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme 5.0 has issued over 4 lakh credit guarantees to support businesses hit by the West Asia crisis.
remember: Approved by Union Cabinet on May 5, 2026|Administered by NCGTC|98% of guarantees by number went to MSMEs
statics: Guarantees issued: 4,11,497|Guaranteed amount: ₹1,55,229 crore|Overall credit target: ₹2.55 lakh crore

title: Key features of the Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) 5.0
body: ECLGS 5.0 offers tiered (not uniform) guarantee coverage to MSMEs, non-MSMEs and the airline sector, valid for loans sanctioned till March 2027.
remember: 100% cover for MSMEs, 90% for non-MSMEs/airlines|5-yr tenor (1-yr moratorium) for MSMEs; 7-yr tenor (2-yr moratorium) for airlines|Zero guarantee fee for lending institutions
statics: Additional credit target ₹2,55,000 crore incl. ₹5,000 crore for airlines|Interest capped at 9% (banks/FIs), 13% (NBFCs)|Valid till March 31, 2027

title: POWERGRID secures JPY 80 billion green loan from JBIC
body: Japan Bank for International Cooperation is funding POWERGRID's Khavda-Nagpur HVDC transmission line that evacuates renewable power from Gujarat to Maharashtra.
remember: Funds Khavda-Nagpur HVDC transmission project|Supports India's 500 GW renewable target by 2030|Part of India-Japan POWERR Asia initiative

title: TPG-led consortium to acquire Aseem Infrastructure Finance from NIIF
body: A consortium of TPG, GIC and ICICI Bank is buying out NIIF's full stake in Aseem Infrastructure Finance, a green-infra NBFC founded in 2020.
remember: TPG to hold 65%, GIC 25%, ICICI Bank up to 5%, rest for ESOPs|NIIF and minority holders (Govt of India, SMBC) fully exiting

title: Nepal's Jestha Varna Mahavihar wins 2025 UNESCO Asia-Pacific Heritage Award
body: The 17th-century Buddhist monastery in Nepal received the Award of Merit after post-earthquake restoration carried out with India's grant assistance.
remember: Category: Award of Merit|Handover ceremony held in Lalitpur|India provided restoration grant assistance

title: Global Citizen Solutions publishes the Global Passport Index (GPI) 2026
body: The Global Passport Index ranks passports using mobility, investment and quality-of-living indicators, distinct from the Henley Index's pure travel-access approach.
remember: Published annually by Global Citizen Solutions (GCS)|Uses 14 indicators across 3 pillars
statics: Pillars: Enhanced Mobility (50%), Investment (25%), Quality of Living (25%)

title: India ranks 125th in the Global Passport Index 2026
body: India slipped one spot from 2025 to rank 125th of 197 countries, trailing in mobility but improving on investment and quality-of-living sub-indices.
remember: Down from 124th (2025)|Ranked behind Namibia (124th), ahead of Azerbaijan (126th)
statics: India: 136th in Mobility, 94th in Investment, 118th in Quality of Living|Visa-free/on-arrival access to 26 destinations

title: Sweden tops the Global Passport Index 2026
body: Sweden claimed the world's strongest passport title with a composite score of 96.05, followed by Switzerland, Finland and Germany.
remember: Top 10 also includes Netherlands, Denmark, Ireland, UK, Norway, Singapore|Afghanistan ranked lowest

title: China launches marine satellite HY-2E to replace HY-2B
body: China's oceanographic satellite HY-2E was launched on a Long March 4B rocket to monitor ocean waves, winds and temperature for disaster prevention.
remember: Launched from Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center|Built by China Academy of Space Technology (CAST)|Replaces the HY-2B satellite
statics: China's 47th space mission of 2026|654th Long March rocket flight

title: Thailand hosts the 2026 U15 & U20 Asian Wrestling Championships
body: Pattaya, Thailand hosted the combined U15 and U20 Asian Wrestling Championships where Indian wrestlers won a large medal haul.
remember: Event held in Pattaya, Thailand

title: India wins 41 medals at 2026 U15 & U20 Asian Wrestling Championships
body: India's combined U15 and U20 contingents won 41 medals in Pattaya, with notable golds from Prathmesh, Naitik, Harshad Keshav and Disha Shokeen.
remember: U20: 20 medals (4G,7S,9B)|U15: 21 medals (8G,6S,7B)|Golds included Vivek Chouhan, Samruddhi Satish Patil, Vinakshi

title: 'Bridge Man of India' Girish Bharadwaj passes away at 76
body: Girish Bharadwaj, honoured with the Padma Shri in 2017 for building low-cost suspension footbridges in remote villages, died in Sullia, Karnataka.
remember: Also called 'Sethu Bandhu'|Built first 55-metre footbridge in 1989 over the Payaswini River

title: Delhi launches Mission Kayakalp to upgrade government school infrastructure
body: The scheme aims to modernise classrooms, repair buildings, improve labs and washrooms, and make campuses more inclusive and green.
remember: Implemented with district administrations, CSR partners and local communities|Focus also on accessibility for children with special needs

title: UP launches Vishwakarma Shram Samman Yojana for traditional artisans
body: The scheme gives artisans free skill training, a toolkit grant and concessional collateral-free loans to boost their livelihoods.
remember: 6-day free skill training|Covers tailoring, carpentry, pottery and other trades

title: West Bengal finalises Pradhan Mantri Cha Shramik Protsahan Yojana
body: PMCSPY aims to improve education, health and infrastructure for tea garden workers in North Bengal through a dedicated financial package.
remember: Implementing agency: North Bengal Development Department|Works with Health Dept and Paschim Banga Samagra Siksha Mission
statics: Financial package: ₹313.3 crore|Expected beneficiaries: over 3 lakh workers

title: World Kiswahili Language Day observed on July 7
body: The day marks Kiswahili's 1954 adoption by the Tanganyika African National Union to unite Africans against colonial rule, and celebrates it as UNESCO's first recognised African language.
remember: First African language officially recognised by UNESCO|Commemorates July 7, 1954 adoption led by Julius Nyerere

title: Madhya Pradesh tops states in new GI tag registrations for 2025-26
body: MP added 26 new Geographical Indication tags, ahead of West Bengal's 24, as part of a nationwide total of 125 new registrations.
remember: West Bengal ranked second|GI tags boost legal protection, exports and artisan livelihoods
statics: MP: 26 new GIs|West Bengal: 24 new GIs|National total: 125 new GIs

title: Kamarajar Port becomes India's second major port with 18-metre draft
body: After Visakhapatnam, Kamarajar Port achieved an 18-metre operational draft following Capital Dredging Phase VI, enabling it to handle fully laden Capesize vessels.
remember: Enables handling of vessels up to 1,70,000 DWT|Deepened approach channels, harbour basin and berths

title: World Badminton Day marked on July 5 with 'Raise a Racket' theme
body: Established by the Badminton World Federation to mark its 1934 founding, the 2026 campaign encourages fans and communities to take up the sport.
remember: Founded by BWF|2026 theme: 'Raise a Racket'

title: PM Modi inaugurates India's first greenfield refinery-cum-petrochemical complex in Rajasthan
body: The HPCL Rajasthan Refinery at Pachpadra, a joint venture between HPCL and the Rajasthan government, aims to boost energy security and industrial growth in the region.
remember: Located at Pachpadra, Balotra district|Joint venture: HPCL and Government of Rajasthan

title: Assam becomes first Indian state to commercially produce Matcha tea
body: Production began at the Chota Tingrai Tea Estate in Tinsukia with support from India-Japan collaboration on Matcha processing techniques.
remember: First batch sold at Guwahati Tea Auction Centre|Backed by India-Japan technical collaboration

title: Nidhi Khare chairs 9th Session of the IGE on Consumer Protection Law and Policy
body: India chaired the UN Trade and Development session in Geneva, highlighting the National Consumer Helpline and the AI-enabled e-Jagriti platform.
remember: Session organised by UN Trade and Development in Geneva|Nidhi Khare is Secretary, Department of Consumer Affairs

title: India hosts BRICS Women Working Group Meeting 2026 in Kochi
body: Held under India's BRICS Chairship, the meeting focused on women's leadership, digital/financial inclusion and their role in climate action and food security.
remember: Held in Kochi, Kerala|Theme: 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'

title: Maharashtra passes Women Farmers' Empowerment Bill 2026
body: The unanimously passed bill is India's first law dedicated to recognising women farmers and ensuring they access welfare schemes, including in fisheries and livestock.
remember: First-of-its-kind law in India for women farmers|Covers agriculture, fisheries and livestock rearing

title: UP launches Rashtriya Parivarik Labh Yojana for BPL families
body: The scheme gives a one-time relief amount to Below Poverty Line families after the death of their primary earning member aged 18-60.
remember: Applicant must be a UP resident and BPL family member

title: 35th Annual Mango Festival inaugurated in New Delhi
body: Delhi's three-day Mango Festival, organised by the Delhi Tourism Department, showcased over 400 mango varieties from across India.
remember: Launched by CM Rekha Gupta|Organised by Delhi Tourism Department

title: GIFT City signs MoU with Vietnam's Da Nang financial hub
body: The pact lets GIFT City, India's sole IFSC, share regulatory and development expertise with Vietnam's new financial hub VIFC-DN to boost cross-border investment.
remember: Covers financial services, fintech, digital innovation and capacity-building|GIFT City positioned as a 'knowledge exporter'

title: Adani's Kutch Copper secures LME brand registration for Grade-A cathodes
body: Kutch Copper Limited's 'Adani Copper' cathodes, produced at its Mundra facility, gained London Metal Exchange 'Good Delivery' status.
remember: Backed by USD 1.2 billion investment|Among world's largest single-location custom copper smelters

title: IMF trims India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.4%
body: The IMF's July update cut India's FY27 forecast slightly while raising the FY28 forecast, keeping India ahead of China and the US in growth terms.
remember: FY27 cut by 10 bps to 6.4% (from 6.5%)|FY28 raised by 20 bps to 6.7%

title: IMF publishes the World Economic Outlook (WEO) report
body: The WEO is IMF's flagship report tracking global growth forecasts; RBI separately cut its own FY27 India forecast from 6.9% to 6.6% in June 2026.
remember: IMF founded 1945, HQ Washington D.C.|Managing Director: Kristalina Georgieva

title: Punjab & Sind Bank gets nod to open IFSC Banking Unit at GIFT City
body: IFSCA cleared the PSU lender's first offshore IBU branch, which will offer foreign currency lending and cross-border trade finance.
remember: RBI approval came in January 2026|IFSCA operational licence granted 7 July 2026

title: Kotak Mutual Fund launches Nifty Private Bank ETF
body: The new ETF tracks the Nifty Private Bank Index, covering India's top 10 private banks, with its NFO open for a week in July.
remember: NFO period: July 8-15, 2026|Categorised as 'Very High' risk

title: India-Japan navies hold PASSEX off the Mumbai coast
body: The Indian Navy and Japan Maritime Self-Defence Force conducted a joint Passage Exercise in the Arabian Sea off Mumbai.
remember: JMSDF ship arrived at Mumbai Port on July 5, 2026 for an operational turnaround

title: INS Surat takes part in PASSEX with Japanese destroyer JS Takanami
body: INS Surat, the fourth and final Visakhapatnam-class (Project 15B) destroyer with 75% indigenous content, exercised alongside JS Takanami (DD-110).
remember: Built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, designed by Navy's Warship Design Bureau|Commissioned in 2025

title: India signs deal to supply Astra Mk1 missiles to Indonesia
body: Indonesia became the first export customer for India's indigenous Astra Mk1 BVRAAM, part of a broader USD 630 million defence cooperation package signed during PM Modi's Jakarta visit.
remember: Developed by DRDO|To be integrated with Su-30 MKI, Tejas Mk1A and Rafale in future
statics: Deal value: ~USD 630 million|Astra Mk1 range: 80-110 km, speed Mach 4.5|Astra Mk2 range: 200 km

title: Tribal Affairs Ministry launches 'TribeX' digital learning platform
body: TribeX offers free certificate courses and UGC-recognised PG diplomas to preserve and promote tribal arts, culture, languages and traditional knowledge.
remember: Launched in Bhubaneswar during a National Workshop on Tribal Research Institutes|Launched by Union Minister Jual Oram

title: India and Costa Rica hold first Joint Economic and Trade Committee meeting
body: The virtual JETCO meeting aimed to deepen bilateral trade ties, addressing standards, food safety and pharmaceutical regulations.
remember: Co-chaired by India's Commerce Dept and Costa Rica's Foreign Trade Ministry

title: PM Modi visits UNESCO-listed Prambanan Temple in Indonesia
body: PM Modi and President Prabowo Subianto visited the 9th-century Hindu temple complex in Yogyakarta to launch a joint cultural conservation project.
remember: Dedicated to Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma|Built by the Sanjaya dynasty|UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1991

title: Landslide hits under-construction Kwar Hydroelectric Project on the Chenab
body: Heavy rain triggered a major landslide near the 540 MW Kwar project in Kishtwar, J&K, being built by Chenab Valley Power Projects Pvt Ltd.
remember: Run-of-river scheme with high dam and underground powerhouse|CVPPL is a joint venture of NHPC (51%) and JKSPDC (49%)

title: Chandigarh becomes first to enter 'Uttam' range in PGI 2.0 for 2025-26
body: Education Ministry's PGI 2.0 report replaced numerical ranks with grades; Chandigarh topped in Uttam-3, while no state reached the top 'Utkarsh' grade.
remember: Meghalaya placed in the lowest 'Akanshi-2' band|Punjab led in learning outcomes
statics: Covers 14.67 lakh schools, 24.72 crore students|State scale: 1,000 points across 73 indicators

title: 'Daksh' introduced as the highest grade in PGI 2.0 and PGI-D
body: Daksh represents scores above 940 out of 1000 points, sitting above the previous top grade Utkarsh in the revised grading framework.
remember: Other grades include Utkarsh, Uttam-1/2/3, Prachesta-1/2/3, Akanshi-1/2/3

title: Stealth frigate Mahendragiri built under Project 17A (Nilgiri-class)
body: INS Mahendragiri (F38) is the sixth Nilgiri-class frigate under the Indian Navy's Project 17A programme.
remember: Sixth ship of the Nilgiri-class|Designed by Warship Design Bureau

title: INS Mahendragiri commissioned at Visakhapatnam, built by Mazagon Dock
body: Built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited, the frigate uses CODOG propulsion and supports maritime security, HADR and search-and-rescue missions.
remember: Commissioning attended by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh|Five earlier ships: Nilgiri, Himgiri, Udaygiri, Taragiri, Vindhyagiri

title: Ministry of Textiles launches Handloom Hackathon 2026 - 'Weaving Innovation'
body: Held as part of National Handloom Day celebrations, the hackathon invites weavers, students and startups to propose scalable solutions for the handloom sector.
remember: Organised by Office of the Development Commissioner (Handlooms)|Open to weavers, students, startups and designers

title: UNCTAD releases the World Investment Report 2026
body: The report tracks global FDI trends, noting a 6% rise in worldwide flows to USD 1.6 trillion in 2025, ending two years of decline.
remember: Developing Asia the largest FDI recipient region
statics: Global FDI 2025: USD 1.6 trillion (up 6%)|Developing Asia share: ~40% (USD 644 billion)

title: India ranks 11th globally as an FDI recipient in 2026 report
body: India moved up two places to become the 11th largest FDI recipient, with inflows rising sharply, and ranks 18th as an outward investor.
remember: FDI inflows rose 44% to USD 39 billion|Outward FDI rose 50% to USD 36 billion

title: United States remains top global FDI destination with $277 billion
body: The US led global FDI inflows in 2025, followed by Singapore, Hong Kong and China according to UNCTAD's report.
remember: Followed by Singapore, Hong Kong, China

title: University of Minnesota creates SpudCell, first fully synthetic cell
body: SpudCell is built entirely from non-living chemical components yet can take in nutrients, replicate DNA and divide, aiding origin-of-life and drug-delivery research.
remember: Bottom-up cell built from scratch, not modified from a living cell|Consists of a lipid membrane enclosing synthetic DNA and enzymes

title: India's higher education GER reaches 30.0% in AISHE 2023-24
body: The AISHE report shows total enrolment crossed 4.5 crore, with female GER (31.2%) surpassing male GER for the seventh straight year of gender parity above 1.0.
remember: ST enrolment grew fastest at 75.7%|OBC enrolment grew 60.2%, SC grew 51.4%
statics: Total enrolment: 4.50 crore (2023-24)|GER: 30.0%|Female GER: 31.2%, Male GER: 30.0%|GPI: 1.08

title: Vihar Lake overflows after heavy Mumbai rainfall
body: One of Mumbai's seven water-supply reservoirs, Vihar Lake was built by the British between 1856-1860 on the Mithi River inside Sanjay Gandhi National Park.
remember: Largest lake in the Salsette group of islands|Located between Tulsi and Powai lakes

title: Eurasian lynx spotted for the first time in Sikkim
body: The medium-sized wild cat, found from Western Europe to the Himalayas, is a solitary, crepuscular carnivore listed as Least Concern by IUCN.
remember: Prefers temperate, boreal and alpine habitats|Mainly active at dawn and dusk

title: Germany to add second Arrow-3 missile defence site in Bavaria
body: Arrow-3, jointly developed by Israel and the US, is an exo-atmospheric system designed to intercept long-range ballistic missiles before re-entry.
remember: Part of the Arrow Weapon System (AWS)|World's first operational stand-alone ATBM defence system

title: Natural History Museum Mizoram named India's 21st Designated Repository
body: Set up in 2022 under Mizoram University in the Indo-Burma hotspot, the museum specialises in taxonomy of ferns, fungi, moths and fishes and supports endemic species conservation.
remember: Recommended by National Biodiversity Authority|Supports conservation of Leptobrachella tamdil amphibian

title: PM Modi conferred Indonesia's highest civilian honour, Bintang Adipurna
body: President Prabowo Subianto presented the honour, instituted in 1959, recognising PM Modi's role in strengthening India-Indonesia ties.
remember: PM Modi's sixth foreign state honour of 2026|Career total foreign honours: 35

title: Indiahandmade: government-backed marketplace for artisans developed by Digital India Corporation
body: Launched in 2023 for the Ministry of Textiles, the platform lets weavers and artisans sell directly to consumers, including GI-tagged and ODOP products.
remember: Offers digital onboarding, free shipping and secure payments
source: Ministry of Textiles / Digital India Corporation

title: ADB cuts India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.6%
body: The Asian Development Outlook lowered its April estimate by 30 basis points, mirroring RBI's own FY27 cut, while keeping the FY28 forecast at 7.3%.
remember: Slightly more optimistic than IMF's 6.4% estimate|India still seen as among fastest-growing major economies

title: IBS Group launches travel-focused AI firm Naviq Technology with $500 million plan
body: Singapore-based IBS Group will invest $500 million over five years in Naviq, targeting aviation, cruise, hospitality and logistics with AI-first tools.
remember: Initial capital injection: over ₹200 crore|Founder: V K Mathews; Naviq President: Moizur Rahman
statics: Investment plan: USD 500 million (~₹4,800 crore) over 5 years

title: Aviva to become first foreign insurer with 100% ownership of its India business
body: UK-based Aviva agreed to buy Dabur Invest Corp's remaining 26% stake, aided by the new 100% FDI limit approved for insurance under the 'Sabka Bima, Sabki Raksha' Bill.
remember: Moves Aviva from 74% to 100% ownership|Aligns with 'Insurance for All by 2047' vision

title: DRDO flight-tests Pinaka Long-Range Guided Rocket's 60 km minimum range
body: Conducted from the Integrated Test Range in Chandipur, Odisha, the trial validated the rocket's minimum strike range after an earlier test confirmed its 120 km maximum range.
remember: Designed by ARDE with HEMRL; DRDL and RCI also involved|Maiden 120 km-range test was in December 2025
statics: Minimum range validated: 60 km|Maximum range (earlier test): 120 km

title: ISRO conducts 5th Integrated Main Parachute Airdrop Test at Sheopur, MP
body: The IMAT-05 test, run at the ADRDE drop zone, validated the Gaganyaan crew module's main parachute system ahead of the uncrewed G1 mission.
remember: Coordinated with DRDO, IAF and Indian Army|Dropped from an Ilyushin Il-76 aircraft

title: IMAT-05 test supports the Gaganyaan human spaceflight mission
body: The test validated structural integrity and load-bearing capacity of the crew module's parachute system, part of a 10-parachute, 4-type recovery design.
remember: Types: Apex Cover Separation, Drogue, Pilot and Main parachutes

title: Aswath S becomes India's 98th Chess Grandmaster
body: The 17-year-old from Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu, sealed his final GM norm at the Pune International GM Round Robin, crossing the 2500 Elo barrier.
remember: 38th GM from Tamil Nadu|Runner-up prize: ₹75,000|Current rating: 2517
